question: Is fail-closed `update_partial` plus operator replanning an acceptable initial recovery contract for uncertain package-installer and Gateway-cron mutations, or must this PR include an operation-identity-based doctor/retry/reconcile workflow before merge?
rationale: The code can report uncertainty, but whether that is an acceptable user-facing mutation contract is a product and operational-ownership choice rather than a mechanical patch defect.

options.title: Require recovery workflow first
options.body: Add and prove a durable doctor/retry/reconcile path with operation identity before enabling grouped mutation.

options.title: Accept experimental partial-state contract
options.body: Keep fail-closed `update_partial` and operator replanning as the initial experimental contract, with the recovery workflow tracked as follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Require recovery workflow first
recommendation.body: Add and prove a durable doctor/retry/reconcile path with operation identity before enabling grouped mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment directly frames the unresolved recovery and escalation-contract decision.
